name: Nerfies
title: Nerfies: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields
authors: Keunhong Park, Utkarsh Sinha, Jonathan T. Barron, Sofien Bouaziz, Dan B Goldman, Steven M. Seitz, Ricardo Martin-Brualla
summary: Turning casually captured videos into portraits that can be viewed from new angles. Nerfies models a moving subject using a deformation field and a neural radiance field.
imageAlt: A reference portrait from the Nerfies interpolation demonstration
videoCaption: Original Nerfies teaser: novel views of deforming scenes.

name: HyperNeRF
title: HyperNeRF: A Higher-Dimensional Representation for Topologically Varying Neural Radiance Fields
authors: Keunhong Park, Utkarsh Sinha, Peter Hedman, Jonathan T. Barron, Sofien Bouaziz, Dan B Goldman, Ricardo Martin-Brualla, Steven M. Seitz
summary: Modeling dynamic scenes whose shapes and connections change over time. HyperNeRF adds higher-dimensional coordinates to represent changes that are difficult to capture with a continuous deformation alone.
imageAlt: The HyperNeRF architecture diagram from the original project website
videoCaption: Original HyperNeRF result: the espresso scene rendered from a stabilized viewpoint.
